description:
Do things with utmost efficiency

Kando is an open source pie menu for your desktop. It offers an unconventional, fast, highly efficient, and fun way of interacting with your computer! You can use it to launch applications, simulate keyboard shortcuts, open files, and much more.
Kando now supports automation workflows! Each menu item can now trigger a sequence of actions which enables all kinds of complex tasks. View the release video to see it in action!
💥 Please note that this version will upgrade your configuration files to the new format, which is not backwards compatible. If you want to be able to switch back to an older version of Kando, make sure to back up your configuration files properly!
- ▶️ Release Video on YouTube
- 💬 Join our Discord server
- 📝 Read the changelog
